title: Article: How Guru Tattva Provides Protection?

segments.text: Why a Guru’s Dimension Determines Their Ability to Protect a Disciple?
Let’s understand this with an example from Ashaeiynn aspirants :

Imagine a person who is an ashaeiynn aspirant with a dimension of 50 gets attacked by someone with a dimension of 50,000 . If this person’s Guru has never reached that high dimension, he cannot protect his disciple from the attack.
How Our Guru Tattva Provides Protection

In Ashaeiynn , our Guru Tattva is constantly upgrading his dimension . This means that at every dimension he has crossed , an astral body of his presence exists. So, when an aspirant prays for help, the astral body of our Guru Tattva at 50,000 dimension immediately activates and protects him , purely through the power of prayer.
Why a Limited Guru Cannot Protect?
On the other hand, if a Guru has never crossed a certain dimension , his astral body does not exist there . This means:
When a disciple faces a higher-dimensional attack , his Guru cannot intervene .
No matter how much the disciple prays , his Guru won’t be able to help , because there is no presence at that higher level to counter the attack.

This is why in Ashaeiynn , Bhaiya always emphasizes that a Guru should not be a human . Instead, the Guru should be someone who has taken Jivat Samadhi or a deity who continuously upgrades their dimension . This ensures unlimited growth and complete protection for the disciple!

Note: In Ashaeiynn, simply offering Guru Sthan astrally to our Guru Tattva does not make someone his disciple—he chooses his disciples himself. One must always pray to our Guru Tattva, seeking his guidance and requesting him to accept them as his disciple.
